MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:27:/-- Two distinct individual-degree-`d` polynomial representatives agree on at
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:28:most an `m * d / |K|` fraction of field points, expressed as a real uniform
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:29:average. This is the scalar collision estimate used before blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:30:`eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`, not the nonencoding-mass estimate itself.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:31:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:32:The field is finite and hence nonempty. No positive dimension, positive degree,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:33:or degree bound relative to the field size is required; representatives are
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:34:not identified merely because their evaluations agree. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:35:theorem polyFunc_eval_collision_le {m d : ℕ} {K : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:36:    [DecidableEq K] (first second : polyFunc m K d) (hne : first ≠ second) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:37:    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:38:      (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:39:        then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤ (m * d : ℝ) / Fintype.card K := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:40:  have havg :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:41:      avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin m → K))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:42:        (fun point => if MvPolynomial.eval point first.1 = MvPolynomial.eval point second.1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:43:          then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:44:        (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:45:    rw [avgOver_uniform_eq_inv_card_mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_filter]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:46:    simp [polynomialAgreementProbability, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:47:  rw [havg]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:48:  have hbound := schwartzZippel_individualDegree first second hne
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:49:  have hreal : (polynomialAgreementProbability m K first.1 second.1 : ℝ) ≤
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:50:      ((((m * d : ℕ) : ℚ≥0) / Fintype.card K) : ℝ) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:51:    exact_mod_cast hbound
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:52:  simpa using hreal
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:53:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:54:/-- The collision hypothesis for the sandwich support comparison on QPBT
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:55:polynomial outcomes, with the field cardinality written as `P.q`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:56:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:57:This specializes `polyFunc_eval_collision_le` to the fixed field model and
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:58:`evalPoly`; it adds no assumptions to the admissible parameter domain of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:59:blueprint `eq:qld-nonencoding-mass`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:60:theorem poly_eval_collision_le {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:61:    (first second : Poly P) (hne : first ≠ second) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:62:    avgOver (uniformDistribution (Fin P.m → PauliScalar P))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:63:      (fun point => if evalPoly first point = evalPoly second point then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ≤
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:64:        (P.m * P.d : ℝ) / P.q := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:65:  have hcard : Fintype.card (PauliScalar P) = P.q :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:66:    @FieldModel.card P.q P.model.toFieldModel
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:67:  unfold evalPoly
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:68:  conv_rhs => rw [← hcard]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:69:  exact polyFunc_eval_collision_le first second hne
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:70:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PolynomialCollision.lean:71:end MIPStarRE.QPBT

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:99:/-- At construction error at most one, a universal extraction coefficient of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:100:at least eighteen absorbs both the proved state error and the Pauli comparison
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:101:error. The collision term and fourth-root scale are exactly those of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:102:`deltaExtract`; there is no parameter-dependent enlargement of the constant. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:103:theorem extraction_small_error_absorption (C delta : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:104:    (hC : 18 ≤ C) (hdelta : 0 ≤ delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:105:    16 * delta ≤ deltaExtract C delta m d q ∧
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:106:      2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:107:        deltaExtract C delta m d q := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:108:  have hroot := Real.self_le_rpow_of_le_one hdelta hdelta_one
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:109:    (by norm_num : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:110:  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt delta ≤ delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:111:    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:112:    exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge' hdelta hdelta_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:113:  have hr : 0 ≤ (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) := by positivity
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:114:  have hp := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:115:    (add_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg hdelta (1 / 4)) hr)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:116:  constructor
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:117:  · exact (show 16 * delta ≤ 18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) +
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:118:      ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:119:  · exact (show 2 * delta + 2 * (((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) + 16 * Real.sqrt delta ≤
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:120:      18 * (delta ^ (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / q) by nlinarith).trans hp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/PauliComparison.lean:121:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:682:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:683:The source absorbs constant factors and the game error into `deltaS`. Here
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:684:`deltaG` is the global polynomial-pair witness error, and
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:685:`deltaConstructPaulis` records that enlargement explicitly.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:686:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:687:The direct placements use the witness fields themselves. The two remaining
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:688:directions follow by transporting the same correlations between the two EPR
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:689:pairs and, for the Bob-first ordering, reversing two Hermitian factors inside
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Consistency.lean:690:the real quadratic form. -/

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:11:# Extraction by the swap unitaries
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:12:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:13:The concrete swap operators below yield the Pauli extraction conclusion. The
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:14:local maps are constructed from the global polynomial
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:15:measurements, and all operators retain the heterogeneous Alice and Bob
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:16:placements. The generalized Pauli projectors use the field and basis fixed by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:17:`P.model`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:18:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:19:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:20:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:21:The extraction witness records the conclusion of blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:22:from
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:23:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1860`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:24:The error-form comparison formalizes `lem:qld-extraction-error-form` and
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:25:supports `rem:pauli-robustness-form` in the blueprint; its paper source is
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:26:lines 1855-1858 and 1868-1876.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:27:-/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:28:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:36:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:37:/-- The concrete conclusion of `lem:qld-unitary`: the two swap maps extract an
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:38:EPR state and conjugate each player's total Pauli measurement to the canonical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:39:Pauli projectors. The answer sum in `pauli_close` is over
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:40:`PauliRegister P`; the uniform distribution on `Unit` records that there is no
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:41:average over questions.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:42:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:43:Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:44:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685,1827-1859`. The swap maps
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:45:are `swapUnitary w .alice` and `swapUnitary w .bob`, defined from the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:46:side-indexed global measurements, and use only the basis fixed by `P.model`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:47:-/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:48:structure ExtractionWitness {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaS : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:49:    (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon) (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaS)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:50:    (delta : ℝ) where
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:51:  /-- Each swap map is a right unitary. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:52:  swap_right_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:53:    swapUnitary w side * (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:54:  /-- Each swap map is a left unitary. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:55:  swap_left_unitary : ∀ side : PlayerSide,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:56:    (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ * swapUnitary w side = 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:57:  /-- The auxiliary state on registers `AA'BB'`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:58:  aux : EuclideanSpace ℂ
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:59:    (ExtractionAuxRegisters P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:60:  /-- The auxiliary state is normalized. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:61:  aux_norm : ‖aux‖ = 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:62:  /-- Applying both concrete swap maps to the expanded state extracts the ideal
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:63:  auxiliary-state/EPR tensor product. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:64:  state_close :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:65:    ‖S.applyBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob) S.psiHat -
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:66:        S.idealExpState aux‖ ^ 2 ≤ delta
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:67:  /-- On the ideal extracted state, conjugated total-Pauli effects are close to
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:68:  the canonical projectors, for both players and both Pauli bases. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:69:  pauli_close : ∀ (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind),
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:70:    opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:71:      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:72:        conjBy (S.placeSide side (swapUnitary w side))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:73:          (S.placePlayer side ((S.pauliMeas side W).effect h)))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:74:      (fun (_ : Unit) (h : PauliRegister P) =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Unitary.lean:75:        S.placeExtractedRegister side (pauliProj W h))

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:3:/-!
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:4:# Extraction foundations
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:5:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:6:This module defines the register identifications used to pull the Pauli
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:7:measurements apart. It retains the distinct local spaces of a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:8:heterogeneous strategy, coarse-grains the generalized Pauli projectors by a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:9:dot product, and records the state and error expressions needed by the later
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:10:extraction witness.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:11:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:12:The binary phases use the existing `phaseSign`; the fixed field basis remains
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:13:the basis stored in `P.model` and is not re-quantified here.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:14:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:15:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:16:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:17:The Pauli dot-product projectors formalize blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:18:`def:tau-dot-product-projector`, from
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:19:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:20:The register and state helpers support blueprint `def:tilde-m-measurement`,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:21:`def:v-swap-unitary`, and `lem:qld-unitary`, from paper lines 1429-1435 and
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:22:1666-1713.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:23:-/

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:85:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:86:/-- Place an operator on one complete extraction block, with the identity on
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:87:the other player's block, as in the side-qualified operators of paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:88:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1429-1435,1687-1713`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:89:noncomputable def placeSide (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:90:    (O : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:91:    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:92:  cases side with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:93:  | alice =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:94:      exact reindexOp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:95:        (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:96:        (heteroKron O 1)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:97:  | bob =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:98:      exact reindexOp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:99:        (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:100:        (heteroKron 1 O)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:101:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:102:/-- Lift an operator on a player's original strategy register to that player's
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:103:full extraction block. This places the Pauli and point measurements appearing
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:104:in blueprint `lem:qld-construct-the-paulis` and `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:105:noncomputable def onPlayer (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:106:    (O : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:107:    Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:108:  heteroKron (heteroKron O 1) 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:109:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:110:/-- Place an operator on the original strategy register of the selected
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:111:player. This is the player-side placement used in blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:112:`lem:qld-unitary`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:113:noncomputable def placePlayer (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε) (side : PlayerSide)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:114:    (O : Op (S.LocalSpace side)) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:115:    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:116:  cases side with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:117:  | alice => exact S.place .AA' (heteroKron O 1)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:118:  | bob => exact S.place .BB' (heteroKron O 1)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:119:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:120:/-- Place an operator on the selected extracted register `A''` or `B''`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:121:The unused strategy register in the crossed placement is assigned the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:122:identity. This is the placement of the ideal Pauli operators in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:123:blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:124:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:125:noncomputable def placeExtractedRegister (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:126:    (side : PlayerSide) (O : Op (PauliRegister P)) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:127:    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:128:  cases side with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:129:  | alice =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:130:      exact S.place .BA'' (heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιB) O)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:131:  | bob =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:132:      exact S.place .AB'' (heteroKron (1 : Op S.toStrategy.ιA) O)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:133:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:134:/-- Place a pair of block operators simultaneously on `AA'A''` and
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:135:`BB'B''`. This is the simultaneous placement used for the transformed state in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:136:blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:137:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:138:noncomputable def placeBoth (S : ProjectiveSetting P ε)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:139:    (VA : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιA))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:140:    (VB : Op (ExtractionBlock P S.toStrategy.ιB)) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:141:    Op (SixReg P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:142:  reindexOp (sixRegExtractionEquiv P S.toStrategy.ιA S.toStrategy.ιB)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:143:    (heteroKron VA VB)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:144:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:145:/-- Apply one operator to each heterogeneous extraction block. This is the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:146:witness-independent state transformation used for `V_A tensor V_B` in

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:172:/-! ## Coarse-grained Pauli projectors -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:173:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:174:/-- Coarse-grain a finite operator family along a map of outcomes. This is the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:175:operator-valued sum corresponding to `Measurement.postprocess`, used by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:176:blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:177:`def:tau-dot-product-projector`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:178:noncomputable def bracketOp {α β ι : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq β]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:179:    (N : α → Op ι) (f : α → β) (b : β) : Op ι :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:180:  ∑ a ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun a => f a = b), N a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:181:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:182:/-- The effect of a postprocessed measurement is the corresponding
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:183:coarse-grained operator sum. This equality is used by blueprint `def:bracket`
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:184:and `def:tau-dot-product-projector`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:185:theorem postprocess_effect_eq_bracketOp {α β ι : Type*}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:186:    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] [DecidableEq β]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:187:    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (f : α → β) (b : β) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:188:    (M.postprocess f).effect b = bracketOp M.effect f b :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:189:  rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:190:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:191:/-- The projector obtained by measuring in basis `W` and retaining outcomes
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:192:whose dot product with `u` is `a`. This is Equation `eq:def-tauwu` in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:193:blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:194:`def:tau-dot-product-projector`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:195:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:196:noncomputable def tauDotProj {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:197:    (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:198:  bracketOp (pauliProj W) (fun h => dotProduct h u) a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:199:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:200:/-- Each dot-product coarse-graining is a projector, as asserted in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:201:blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:202:`lem:tau-dot-product-projective`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:203:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:204:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:205:Completeness makes the matrix of Pauli basis vectors unitary. The coarse-grained
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:206:operator is the conjugate of the diagonal projector onto the specified outcomes. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:207:theorem tauDotProj_isProj {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:208:    (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:209:    IsProj (tauDotProj W u a) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:210:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:211:  let basisMatrix : Op (PauliRegister P) := fun row label => pauliVec W label row
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:212:  have hbasis : basisMatrix * basisMatrixᴴ = 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:213:    calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:214:      basisMatrix * basisMatrixᴴ = ∑ label : PauliRegister P, pauliProj W label := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:215:        ext row column
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:216:        simp [basisMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, pauliProj, Matrix.sum_apply,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:217:          Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:218:      _ = 1 := sum_pauliProj_eq_one W
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:219:  let diagonalProj : Op (PauliRegister P) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:220:    Matrix.diagonal (fun label => if dotProduct label u = a then (1 : ℂ) else 0)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:221:  have hdiagonal : IsProj diagonalProj := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:222:    constructor
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:223:    · change Matrix.diagonal _ * Matrix.diagonal _ = Matrix.diagonal _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:224:      rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:225:      congr 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:226:      funext label
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:227:      split_ifs <;> simp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:228:    · change diagonalProjᴴ = diagonalProj
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:229:      simp [diagonalProj, Matrix.diagonal_conjTranspose]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:230:  have hcoarse : tauDotProj W u a = basisMatrix * diagonalProj * basisMatrixᴴ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:231:    ext row column
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:232:    simp only [tauDotProj, bracketOp, Matrix.sum_apply, pauliProj, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:233:    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:234:    simp only [diagonalProj, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:235:    simp [basisMatrix, Finset.sum_filter, mul_ite, ite_mul]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:236:  rw [hcoarse]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:237:  exact hdiagonal.map (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℂ (Op (PauliRegister P))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:238:    ⟨basisMatrix, Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mpr hbasis⟩)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:239:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:240:/-- For fixed `W` and `u`, the dot-product projectors sum to the identity.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:241:This is the completeness assertion of blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:242:`lem:tau-dot-product-projective`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:243:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:244:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:245:The dot-product fibers partition the complete Pauli outcome family. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:246:theorem sum_tauDotProj_eq_one {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:247:    (u : PauliRegister P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:248:    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, tauDotProj W u a = 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:249:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:250:  unfold tauDotProj bracketOp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:251:  rw [Finset.sum_fiberwise]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:252:  exact sum_pauliProj_eq_one W
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:253:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:254:open scoped MatrixOrder ComplexOrder in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:255:/-- Distinct dot-product fibers give orthogonal coarse-grained Pauli projectors.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:256:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:257:This formalization-only companion follows from projectivity and completeness
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:258:using the existing projective-measurement orthogonality theorem. The source
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:259:definition is `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1426-1429`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:260:theorem tauDotProj_mul_eq_zero_of_ne {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:261:    (u : PauliRegister P) {a b : PauliScalar P} (hab : a ≠ b) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:262:    tauDotProj W u a * tauDotProj W u b = 0 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:263:  let M : Measurement (PauliScalar P) (PauliRegister P) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:264:    Measurement.ofSumEqOne (tauDotProj W u)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:265:      (fun c => (tauDotProj_isProj W u c).nonneg) (sum_tauDotProj_eq_one W u)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:266:  exact DistanceCalculus.projective_effect_mul_effect_eq_zero
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:267:    M (tauDotProj_isProj W u) hab
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:268:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:269:/-! ## Conjugation and extraction error -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:270:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:271:/-- Conjugation of an operator by a square matrix, as used in the exact
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:272:conjugation equations in blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:273:`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:274:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1713`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:275:noncomputable def conjBy {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:276:    (V N : Op ι) : Op ι :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:277:  V * N * Vᴴ
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:278:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:279:/-- The common error scale for constructing the pulled-apart measurements from
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:280:a global polynomial-pair witness. Here `deltaG` is its consistency error. The
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:281:remaining terms record the point-measurement transfer
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:282:and the Schwartz--Zippel loss; when `0 ≤ epsilon ≤ 1`, `sqrt epsilon` also
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:283:dominates terms of order `epsilon`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:284:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:285:This makes explicit the enlargement of the error called `deltaS` in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:286:blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:287:`lem:qld-construct-the-paulis`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:288:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1458-1605`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:289:noncomputable def deltaConstructPaulis (C epsilon deltaG : ℝ)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:290:    (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:291:  C * (deltaG + Real.sqrt epsilon +
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:292:    ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:293:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:294:/-- The explicit extraction scale
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:295:`C * (deltaS^(1/4) + md/q)` from blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:296:`lem:qld-unitary`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:297:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1666-1685`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:298:noncomputable def deltaExtract (C deltaS : ℝ) (m d q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:299:  C * (Real.rpow deltaS (1 / 4 : ℝ) + ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ) / (q : ℝ))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:300:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:301:end
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:302:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Defs.lean:303:end MIPStarRE.QPBT

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:5:# Observable consistency after the concrete swaps
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:6:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:7:Unitary conjugation transports the supplied-witness observable estimate to
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:8:the canonical Pauli operators on the extracted registers. This is the input

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:10:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:11:## References
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:12:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:13:Blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`; paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:14:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1701-1724`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:15:-/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:16:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:25:private theorem conjBy_reindexOp {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:26:    (e : I ≃ J) (U A : Op J) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:27:    conjBy (reindexOp e U) (reindexOp e A) = reindexOp e (conjBy U A) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:28:  rw [conjBy, ← ProjectiveSetting.reindexOp_conjTranspose,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:29:    ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, ← WinImplications.reindexOp_mul, conjBy]

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:32:    (U A : Op I) (V B : Op J) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:33:    conjBy (heteroKron U V) (heteroKron A B) =

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:35:  simp only [conjBy, MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_conjTranspose, heteroKron_mul]

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:37:/-- Simultaneous swaps conjugate each local operator by its own swap. This
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:38:retains the heterogeneous local spaces in the calculation at paper lines 1701-1713. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:39:theorem ProjectiveSetting.conjBy_placeBoth_swap_placeSide
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:40:    {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon deltaG : ℝ} (S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:41:    (w : GlobalPairWitness S deltaG) (side : PlayerSide)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:42:    (A : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side))) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:43:    conjBy (S.placeBoth (swapUnitary w .alice) (swapUnitary w .bob)) (S.placeSide side A) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:44:      S.placeSide side (conjBy (swapUnitary w side) A) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:45:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:46:  cases side <;> simp only [ProjectiveSetting.placeBoth, ProjectiveSetting.placeSide,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:47:    conjBy_reindexOp, conjBy_heteroKron]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:48:  · congr 2
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:49:    change swapUnitary w .bob * 1 * (swapUnitary w .bob)ᴴ = 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:50:    rw [Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:51:  · congr 2
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:52:    change swapUnitary w .alice * 1 * (swapUnitary w .alice)ᴴ = 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:53:    rw [Matrix.mul_one, swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:54:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:55:/-- Conjugating both operator families and the state by the same unitary
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/SwappedConsistency.lean:56:preserves their state-dependent distance. -/

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:6:# Transfer of the complete Pauli overlap between states
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:7:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:8:A selected sum of effects of a complete measurement is a positive contraction.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:9:Applied to the product measurement, this bounds the complete overlap operator,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:10:independently of the number of answers. Its expectation changes by at most twice
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:11:the distance between unit vectors. Schwartz--Zippel then removes unequal Pauli
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:12:encodings after the change of state.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:31:theorem norm_apply_measurement_sum_le {α ι : Type*} [Fintype α]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:32:    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Measurement α ι) (s : Finset α)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:33:    (psi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:34:    ‖applyOperatorToState (∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a) psi‖ ≤ ‖psi‖ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:35:  have hpos : 0 ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun a _ => M.pos a)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:36:  have hle : ∑ a ∈ s, M.effect a ≤ 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:37:    rw [← M.sum_eq_one]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:38:    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ s)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:39:      (fun a _ _ => M.pos a)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:40:  apply MagicSquareRigidity.norm_applyOperatorToState_le
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:41:  rw [(Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp hpos).isHermitian.eq]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:42:  exact (MIPStarRE.Quantum.sq_le_self hpos hle).trans hle
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:43:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:44:/-- Changing a unit vector changes the expectation of a contraction by at most
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:45:twice the vector distance. No positivity or self-adjointness is required. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:46:theorem abs_stateQForm_sub_le_of_contraction {ι : Type*}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:47:    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (T : Op ι)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:48:    (hT : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι, ‖applyOperatorToState T v‖ ≤ ‖v‖)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:49:    (psi phi : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (hpsi : ‖psi‖ = 1) (hphi : ‖phi‖ = 1) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:50:    |stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T| ≤ 2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:51:  have hsplit : stateQForm psi T - stateQForm phi T =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:52:      (inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re +
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:53:        (inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:54:    simp [stateQForm, applyOperatorToState]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:55:  rw [hsplit]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:56:  calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:57:    _ ≤ |(inner ℂ (psi - phi) (applyOperatorToState T psi)).re| +
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:58:        |(inner ℂ phi (applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi))).re| := abs_add_le _ _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:59:    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T psi‖ +
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:60:        ‖phi‖ * ‖applyOperatorToState T (psi - phi)‖ :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:61:      add_le_add ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:62:        ((Complex.abs_re_le_norm _).trans (norm_inner_le_norm _ _))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:63:    _ ≤ ‖psi - phi‖ * ‖psi‖ + ‖phi‖ * ‖psi - phi‖ :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:64:      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT psi) (norm_nonneg _))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:65:        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hT (psi - phi)) (norm_nonneg _))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:66:    _ = _ := by rw [hpsi, hphi]; ring

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:69:change of unit state. The tensor factors can have different dimensions. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:70:theorem abs_diagonal_overlap_state_sub_le {α I J : Type*}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:71:    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:72:    [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] (A : Measurement α I) (B : Measurement α J)

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:74:    |(∑ a, stateQForm psi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))) -
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:75:      ∑ a, stateQForm phi (heteroKron (A.effect a) (B.effect a))| ≤
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:76:        2 * ‖psi - phi‖ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:77:  let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun ab : α × α => ab.1 = ab.2)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:78:  have heq : (∑ ab ∈ s, (tensorMeasurement A B).effect ab) =

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/OverlapTransfer.lean:81:      Measurement.ofSumEqOne]

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:5:# The EPR projection in Pauli extraction
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:6:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:7:The product of the averaged, paired X and Z observables is the rank-one
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:8:projection onto the EPR vector. This is an algebraic prerequisite for constructing
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:9:the auxiliary state in `exists_extractionWitness_ofGlobalPairWitness`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:10:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:12:

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:14:`references/qpbt-paper/14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1725-1742`.

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:25:variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:26:  [Algebra (ZMod 2) K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:27:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:28:/-- The operator `H_W` of the EPR projection argument, averaged over all
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:29:generalized Pauli labels. Paper lines 1725-1733 define this average after
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:30:reindexing by a nonzero element of the binary basis. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:31:def pauliCorrelation (W : PauliKind) : Op ((ι → K) × (ι → K)) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:32:  (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:33:    ∑ u : ι → K, heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:34:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:35:private theorem avg_phaseSign_dotProduct (v : ι → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:36:    (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:37:        ∑ u : ι → K, phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u v)) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:38:      if v = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:39:  have h := congrArg (fun A : Op (ι → K) => A v v)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:40:    (pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable .Z (0 : ι → K))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:41:  have hv : pauliProj .Z (0 : ι → K) v v = if v = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:42:    change (∏ i, if v i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:43:      star (∏ i, if v i = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:44:    simp only [Fintype.prod_boole, ← funext_iff]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:45:    change (if v = 0 then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * star (if v = 0 then 1 else 0) = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:46:    split <;> simp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:47:  simp only [dotProduct_zero, map_zero, phaseSign, ite_true, one_smul] at h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:48:  rw [hv] at h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:49:  simpa only [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:50:    tauObservable_Z_apply, ite_true, one_mul] using h.symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:51:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:52:/-- The Z correlation projects onto equal computational-basis labels.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:53:This is the Fourier cancellation in paper lines 1736-1740. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:54:theorem pauliCorrelation_Z_apply (x y : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:55:    pauliCorrelation .Z x y = if x = y ∧ y.1 = y.2 then 1 else 0 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:56:  simp only [pauliCorrelation, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:57:    heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:58:  simp_rw [tauObservable_Z_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:59:  by_cases hxy : x = y
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:60:  · subst x
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:61:    simp only [ite_true, true_and]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:62:    have hphase (u : ι → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:63:        phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u y.1)) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:64:            phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u y.2)) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:65:          phaseSign (binTrace K (dotProduct u (y.1 + y.2))) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:66:      rw [← phaseSign_add, dotProduct_add, map_add]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:67:    simp_rw [hphase]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:68:    rw [avg_phaseSign_dotProduct]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:69:    letI : CharP K 2 := (Algebra.charP_iff (ZMod 2) K 2).mp (ZMod.charP 2)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:70:    simp only [funext_iff, Pi.add_apply, Pi.zero_apply, CharTwo.add_eq_zero]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:71:  · have h : x.1 ≠ y.1 ∨ x.2 ≠ y.2 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:72:      by_contra h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:73:      push Not at h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:74:      exact hxy (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:75:    rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h, hxy]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:76:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:77:/-- On a diagonal input, the X correlation is uniform over diagonal outputs.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:78:This is the shift average in paper lines 1739-1742. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:79:theorem pauliCorrelation_X_apply_diagonal (x : (ι → K) × (ι → K)) (a : ι → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:80:    pauliCorrelation .X x (a, a) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:81:      if x.1 = x.2 then (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:82:  simp only [pauliCorrelation, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:83:    heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:84:  simp_rw [tauObservable_X_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:85:  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (x.1 - a)]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:86:  · simp [add_sub_cancel, eq_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:87:  · intro u _ hu
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:88:    have h : x.1 ≠ a + u := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:89:      intro h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:90:      apply hu
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:91:      rw [h, add_sub_cancel_left]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:92:    simp [h]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:93:  · simp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:94:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:95:/-- The product `H_X H_Z` is the ordinary rank-one EPR projection, with no
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:96:normalized-trace factor. This is the identity at paper lines 1735-1742 used
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:97:to construct the auxiliary state in blueprint `lem:qld-unitary`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:98:theorem pauliCorrelation_mul_eq_epr :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:99:    pauliCorrelation (K := K) (ι := ι) .X * pauliCorrelation .Z =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:100:      Matrix.vecMulVec (fun x => eprState (ι → K) x)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:101:        (fun y => star (eprState (ι → K) y)) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:102:  ext x y
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:103:  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:104:  simp_rw [pauliCorrelation_Z_apply]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:105:  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:106:  · by_cases hy : y.1 = y.2
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:107:    · rcases y with ⟨a, b⟩
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:108:      dsimp only at hy
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:109:      subst b
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:110:      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, mul_one, pauliCorrelation_X_apply_diagonal]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:111:      change (if x.1 = x.2 then (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0) =

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:113:          star (if a = a then (Real.sqrt (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℝ) : ℂ)⁻¹ else 0)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:114:      by_cases hx : x.1 = x.2
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:115:      · rw [if_pos hx, if_pos hx, if_pos rfl]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:116:        exact (inv_sqrt_natCast_mul_conj (Fintype.card (ι → K))).symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:117:      · simp [hx]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:118:    · simp [hy, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, eprState]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:119:  · intro z _ hz
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:120:    simp [hz]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:121:  · simp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:122:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:123:/-- Each Pauli correlation average, with an arbitrary auxiliary register,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:124:is a contraction. The triangle inequality
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:125:and the unitarity of its summands justify the norm estimate used in paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:126:lines 1743-1750, independently of any strategy-consistency hypothesis. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:127:theorem norm_heteroKron_pauliCorrelation_apply_le {R : Type*}

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:129:    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (R × ((ι → K) × (ι → K)))) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:130:    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ‖ ≤ ‖ψ‖ := by

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:133:  have hnorm (u : ι → K) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:134:      ‖applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:139:      heteroKron 1 (heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u)) = 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:140:    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, tauObservable_conjTranspose_mul_self,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:141:      heteroKron_one_one, Matrix.one_mul, heteroKron_one_one]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:142:  have haction : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (1 : Op R) (pauliCorrelation W)) ψ =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:143:      (Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ • ∑ u : ι → K,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:144:        applyOperatorToState (U u) ψ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:145:    change applyOperatorToState
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:146:      ((Matrix.kroneckerBilinear (R := ℂ) (α := ℂ) (1 : Op R))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:147:        ((Fintype.card (ι → K) : ℂ)⁻¹ •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:148:          ∑ u : ι → K, heteroKron (tauObservable W u) (tauObservable W u))) ψ = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/EPRProjection.lean:149:    simp only [map_smul, map_sum, applyOperatorToState, LinearMap.sum_apply,

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:40:`def:s-w-marginals`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:41:def selectPoly {P : AdmissibleParams} (W : PauliKind) : PolyPair P -> Poly P
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:42:  | pair => match W with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:43:    | .X => pair.1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:44:    | .Z => pair.2
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:45:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:46:end PauliKind
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:47:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:48:namespace GlobalPairWitness
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:49:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:50:/-- The single-basis marginal of the global polynomial-pair measurement.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:51:This is blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:52:`def:s-w-marginals`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:53:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1421-1423`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:54:noncomputable def marginalPoly {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:55:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:56:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:57:    Measurement (Poly P) (S.ExpandedLocalSpace side) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:58:  (w.Smeas side).postprocess W.selectPoly
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:59:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:60:/-- The single-basis marginal remains a projective measurement. This is the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:61:projectivity assertion implicit in blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:62:`def:s-w-marginals`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:63:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1421-1423`. Finite postprocessing
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:64:preserves projectivity, independently of the construction of the joint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:65:measurement. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:66:theorem marginalPoly_isProjective {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:67:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:68:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) :

MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:70:  exact SandwichProduct.postprocess_isProjective
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:71:    (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side) W.selectPoly
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:72:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:73:end GlobalPairWitness
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:74:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:75:/-- The pulled-apart projective-measurement effect from Equation `eq:tilde_M`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:76:The polynomial marginal acts on the player's expanded local space and the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:77:dot-product projector acts on the newly adjoined register. Blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:78:`eq:tilde_M`; paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:79:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1425-1435`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:80:noncomputable def tildeM {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:81:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:82:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:83:    (a : PauliScalar P) : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:84:  ∑ g : Poly P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:85:    heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:86:      (tauDotProj W u (dotProduct (decodeFq g) u - a))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:87:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:88:/-- Each pulled-apart effect is a projector, as asserted in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:89:blueprint `lem:tilde-m-projective`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:90:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1425-1435`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:91:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:92:Each tensor summand is projective. Distinct polynomial marginals are
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:93:orthogonal, so their tensor summands are orthogonal as well. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:94:theorem tildeM_isProj {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:95:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:96:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:97:    (a : PauliScalar P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:98:    IsProj (tildeM w side W u a) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:99:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:100:  have hproj (g : Poly P) : IsProj
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:101:      (heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:102:        (tauDotProj W u (dotProduct (decodeFq g) u - a))) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:103:    MakingMeasurementsProjective.isProj_kronecker
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:104:      (w.marginalPoly_isProjective side W g) (tauDotProj_isProj W u _)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:105:  unfold tildeM
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:106:  constructor
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:107:  · change (∑ g : Poly P, _) * (∑ g : Poly P, _) = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:108:    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:109:    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:110:    rw [Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single g]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:111:    · exact (hproj g).isIdempotentElem
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:112:    · intro g' _ hg'
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:113:      rw [heteroKron_mul, MagicSquareRigidity.mul_eq_zero_of_isProj_family
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:114:        (w.marginalPoly_isProjective side W) (w.marginalPoly side W).sum_le_one
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:115:        hg'.symm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:116:      simp [heteroKron]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:117:    · intro hg
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:118:      exact (hg (Finset.mem_univ g)).elim
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:119:  · change (∑ g : Poly P, _)ᴴ = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:120:    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_sum]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:121:    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => (hproj g).isSelfAdjoint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:122:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:123:/-- The pulled-apart effects are complete for each fixed basis and Pauli
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:124:register vector. This is the completeness assertion in
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:125:blueprint `lem:tilde-m-projective`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:126:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1425-1435`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:127:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:128:For each polynomial, subtracting the scalar outcome from its decoded dot
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:129:product permutes the field. Completeness then follows by summing the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:130:dot-product projectors and the polynomial marginal effects. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:131:theorem sum_tildeM_eq_one {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:132:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:133:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:134:    ∑ a : PauliScalar P, tildeM w side W u a = 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:135:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:136:  simp only [tildeM]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:137:  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:138:  calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:139:    _ = ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:140:        (∑ a : PauliScalar P, tauDotProj W u (dotProduct (decodeFq g) u - a)) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:141:      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:142:        (DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right _ _ _).symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:143:    _ = ∑ g : Poly P, heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect g) 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:144:      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:145:      congr 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:146:      calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:147:        _ = ∑ a : PauliScalar P, tauDotProj W u a :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:148:          (Equiv.subLeft (dotProduct (decodeFq g) u)).sum_comp (tauDotProj W u)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:149:        _ = 1 := sum_tauDotProj_eq_one W u
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:150:    _ = heteroKron (∑ g : Poly P, (w.marginalPoly side W).effect g) 1 :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:151:      (DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left _ _ _).symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:152:    _ = 1 := by rw [(w.marginalPoly side W).sum_eq_one, heteroKron_one_one]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:153:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:154:/-- The binary observable obtained from the trace coarse-graining of `tildeM`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:155:This is Equation `eq:def-tildewj` in blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:156:`def:tilde-w-observables`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:157:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1437-1442`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:158:noncomputable def tildeObs {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:159:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:160:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:161:    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:162:  ∑ a : PauliScalar P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:163:    phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * a)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:164:      tildeM w side W u a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:165:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:166:/-- Fourier regrouping of the dot-product effects after translating their
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:167:outcomes. This is the change of variables in the product calculation at paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:168:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1442-1450`, supporting blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:169:`lem:tildew-product-form`. It uses only the definition of the coarse-graining,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:170:not its projectivity. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:171:private theorem sum_phaseSign_tauDotProj_sub {params : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:172:    (kind : PauliKind) (vector : PauliRegister params)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:173:    (coefficient offset : PauliScalar params) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:174:    (∑ value : PauliScalar params,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:175:      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace params.model (coefficient * value)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:176:        tauDotProj kind vector (offset - value)) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:177:      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace params.model (coefficient * offset)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:178:        tauObservable kind (coefficient • vector) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:179:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:180:  calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:181:    _ = ∑ value : PauliScalar params,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:182:        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace params.model (coefficient * (offset - value))) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:183:          tauDotProj kind vector value := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:184:      symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:185:      simpa using (Equiv.subLeft offset).sum_comp
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:186:        (fun value => phaseSign (fixedBinTrace params.model (coefficient * value)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:187:          tauDotProj kind vector (offset - value))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:188:    _ = ∑ label : PauliRegister params,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:189:        phaseSign (fixedBinTrace params.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:190:          (coefficient * (offset - dotProduct label vector))) • pauliProj kind label := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:191:      simp only [tauDotProj, bracketOp, Finset.smul_sum]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:192:      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ (fun label => dotProduct label vector)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:193:        (fun label => phaseSign (fixedBinTrace params.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:194:          (coefficient * (offset - dotProduct label vector))) • pauliProj kind label)]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:195:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:196:      intro value _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:197:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:198:      intro label hlabel
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:199:      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hlabel).2]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:200:    _ = _ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:201:      rw [tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj, Finset.smul_sum]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:202:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:203:      intro label _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:204:      rw [smul_smul, smul_dotProduct, smul_eq_mul, dotProduct_comm vector label]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:205:      congr 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:206:      rw [mul_sub, fixedBinTrace, map_sub, sub_eq_add_neg,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:207:        ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two, phaseSign_add]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:208:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:209:/-- Product form of the pulled-apart observable, Equation
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:210:`eq:tildewj-product-form` of `lem:tildew-product-form`. Blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:211:`lem:tildew-product-form`; paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:212:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1442-1450`. The finite Fourier
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:213:regrouping uses `tauObservable_eq_sum_pauliProj` and the definitions of both
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:214:marginalizations, independently of dot-product projectivity or consistency
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:215:estimates. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:216:theorem tildeObs_eq_heteroKron {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:217:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:218:    (side : PlayerSide) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:219:    (j : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:220:    tildeObs w side W u j =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:221:      heteroKron
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:222:        (∑ pair : PolyPair P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:223:          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:224:            (P.model.basis j * dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:225:            (w.Smeas side).effect pair)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:226:        (tauObservable W (P.model.basis j • u)) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:227:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:228:  simp only [tildeObs, tildeM, Finset.smul_sum]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:229:  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:230:  calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:231:    _ = ∑ polynomial : Poly P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:232:        heteroKron ((w.marginalPoly side W).effect polynomial)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:233:          (∑ value : PauliScalar P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:234:            phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model (P.model.basis j * value)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:235:              tauDotProj W u (dotProduct (decodeFq polynomial) u - value)) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:236:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:237:      intro polynomial _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:238:      rw [DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_right]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:239:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:240:      intro value _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:241:      exact (Matrix.kronecker_smul _ _ _).symm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:242:    _ = heteroKron
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:243:        (∑ polynomial : Poly P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:244:          phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:245:            (P.model.basis j * dotProduct (decodeFq polynomial) u)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:246:              (w.marginalPoly side W).effect polynomial)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:247:        (tauObservable W (P.model.basis j • u)) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:248:      simp_rw [sum_phaseSign_tauDotProj_sub]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:249:      rw [DistanceCalculus.heteroKron_finset_sum_left]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:250:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:251:      intro polynomial _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:252:      simp only [heteroKron, Matrix.kronecker, Matrix.kronecker_smul,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:253:        Matrix.smul_kronecker]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:254:    _ = _ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:255:      congr 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:256:      simp only [GlobalPairWitness.marginalPoly, Measurement.postprocess_effect,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:257:        Finset.smul_sum]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:258:      rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise Finset.univ W.selectPoly
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:259:        (fun pair => phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:260:          (P.model.basis j * dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:261:            (w.Smeas side).effect pair)]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:262:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:263:      intro polynomial _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:264:      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:265:      intro pair hpair
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:266:      rw [(Finset.mem_filter.mp hpair).2]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:267:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:268:/-- The complex binary character agrees with the real sign used in spectral sums.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:269:This formalization-only identity permits its use
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:270:in the involution and commutation assertions of `lem:tildew-product-form`. -/
