MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:326:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:327:**Local fix:** the paper drops this phase when `j != j'`, which is false for
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:328:general register vectors; see `docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_cross-basis-phase.tex`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:329:The sign-weighted sums of the joint projectors commute, leaving exactly the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:330:phase of `tauObservable_X_mul_Z`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:331:theorem tildeObs_twisted_commutation {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:332:    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:333:    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:334:    (u v : PauliRegister P) (j j' : Fin P.model.basisDim) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:335:    tildeObs w side .X u j * tildeObs w side .Z v j' =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:336:      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:337:        (P.model.basis j * P.model.basis j' * dotProduct u v)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:338:        (tildeObs w side .Z v j' * tildeObs w side .X u j) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:339:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:340:  have hcomm := MagicSquareRigidity.signObs_comm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:341:    (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:342:    (fun pair => fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:343:      (P.model.basis j * dotProduct (decodeFq (PauliKind.X.selectPoly pair)) u))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:344:    (fun pair => fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:345:      (P.model.basis j' * dotProduct (decodeFq (PauliKind.Z.selectPoly pair)) v))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:346:  simp only [MagicSquareRigidity.signObs, ← phaseSign_eq_complex_bitSign] at hcomm
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:347:  rw [tildeObs_eq_heteroKron, tildeObs_eq_heteroKron,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:348:    heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, tauObservable_X_mul_Z,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:349:    MagicSquareRigidity.heteroKron_smul_right, hcomm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:350:  congr 2
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:351:  simp only [fixedBinTrace, smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:352:    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:353:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:354:/-! ## Swap conjugation -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:355:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:356:/-- Each crossed Pauli product is unitary, by the two involution identities
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:357:used at paper `14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1699`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:358:private theorem swapPauli_mul_conjTranspose {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:359:    (pair : PolyPair P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:360:    (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1)) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:361:        (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))ᴴ = 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:362:  rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, tauObservable_conjTranspose,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:363:    tauObservable_conjTranspose, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:364:    Matrix.mul_assoc (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2)), tauObservable_sq,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:365:    Matrix.mul_one, tauObservable_sq]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:366:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:367:/-- The crossed Pauli factors acquire the phase determined by the selected
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:368:polynomial. This is the commutation identity used at paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:369:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1701-1713`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:370:private theorem swapPauli_mul_tauObservable {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:371:    (pair : PolyPair P) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:372:    (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1)) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:373:        tauObservable W u =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:374:      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:375:        (dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u)) •
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:376:        (tauObservable W u *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:377:          (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:378:  cases W with
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:379:  | X =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:380:      have hcomm : tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .X u =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:381:          tauObservable .X u * tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:382:        rw [tauObservable_mul, tauObservable_mul, add_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:383:      have hcross := congrArg
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:384:        (fun A : Op (PauliRegister P) =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:385:          phaseSign (binTrace (PauliScalar P) (dotProduct u (decodeFq pair.1))) • A)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:386:        (tauObservable_X_mul_Z u (decodeFq pair.1))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:387:      simp only [smul_smul, phaseSign_mul_self, one_smul] at hcross
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:388:      simp only [PauliKind.selectPoly, fixedBinTrace]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:389:      rw [dotProduct_comm (decodeFq pair.1) u]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:390:      calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:391:        _ = tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:392:            (tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1) * tauObservable .X u) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:393:          Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:394:        _ = _ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:395:          rw [← hcross, Matrix.mul_smul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hcomm, Matrix.mul_assoc]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:396:  | Z =>
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:397:      have hcomm : tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1) * tauObservable .Z u =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:398:          tauObservable .Z u * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:399:        rw [tauObservable_mul, tauObservable_mul, add_comm]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:400:      simp only [PauliKind.selectPoly, fixedBinTrace]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:401:      calc
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:402:        _ = tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:403:            (tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1) * tauObservable .Z u) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:404:          Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:405:        _ = _ := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:406:          rw [hcomm, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, tauObservable_X_mul_Z,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:407:            Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:408:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:409:/-- Conjugating a Pauli observable by the crossed Pauli factors multiplies it
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:410:by the selected binary phase, as in paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:411:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1701-1713`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:412:private theorem swapPauli_conj_tauObservable {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:413:    (pair : PolyPair P) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:414:    conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:415:        (tauObservable W u) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:416:      phaseSign (fixedBinTrace P.model
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:417:        (dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u)) • tauObservable W u := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:418:  rw [conjBy, swapPauli_mul_tauObservable, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:419:    swapPauli_mul_conjTranspose, Matrix.mul_one]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:420:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:421:/-- Fourier inversion turns the Pauli conjugation phase into a translation of
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:422:the projector label. This is the projector identity used at paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:423:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1805-1822`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:424:private theorem swapPauli_conj_pauliProj {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:425:    (pair : PolyPair P) (W : PauliKind) (h : PauliRegister P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:426:    conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:427:        (pauliProj W h) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:428:      pauliProj W (h + decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:429:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:430:  rw [pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable, conjBy, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:431:    Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, pauliProj_eq_avg_tauObservable]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:432:  congr 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:433:  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:434:  intro u _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:435:  rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:436:  change _ • conjBy _ _ = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:437:  rw [swapPauli_conj_tauObservable, smul_smul]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:438:  congr 1
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:439:  rw [fixedBinTrace, ← phaseSign_add, ← map_add,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:440:    dotProduct_comm (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u, dotProduct_add]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:441:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:442:/-- Translation of the Pauli label translates its dot-product outcome. This
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:443:is the finite reindexing in paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:444:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1805-1822`; it does not require a
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:445:polynomial to be in the image of the low-degree encoding. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:446:private theorem swapPauli_conj_tauDotProj {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:447:    (pair : PolyPair P) (W : PauliKind) (u : PauliRegister P) (a : PauliScalar P) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:448:    conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:449:        (tauDotProj W u a) =
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:450:      tauDotProj W u (a + dotProduct (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)) u) := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:451:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:452:  simp only [tauDotProj, bracketOp, conjBy, Matrix.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:453:  change (∑ h ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun h => dotProduct h u = a),
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:454:    conjBy (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) * tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:455:      (pauliProj W h)) = _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:456:  simp_rw [swapPauli_conj_pauliProj]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:457:  apply Finset.sum_equiv (Equiv.addRight (decodeFq (W.selectPoly pair)))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:458:  · intro h
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:459:    simp [add_dotProduct]
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:460:  · intro h _
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:461:    rfl
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:462:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:463:/-- The swap map built from the global polynomial-pair measurement, with the
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:464:crossed decoded arguments required by `def:v-swap-unitary`. Blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:465:`def:v-swap-unitary`; paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:466:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1700`. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:467:noncomputable def swapUnitary {P : AdmissibleParams} {epsilon delta : ℝ}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:468:    {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon} (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:469:    (side : PlayerSide) : Op (ExtractionBlock P (S.LocalSpace side)) :=
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:470:  ∑ pair : PolyPair P,
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:471:    heteroKron ((w.Smeas side).effect pair)
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:472:      (tauObservable .X (decodeFq pair.2) *
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:473:        tauObservable .Z (decodeFq pair.1))
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:474:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:475:/-- The swap map is a right unitary. This is the first exact unitarity
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:476:calculation of blueprint
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:477:`lem:v-swap-conjugation`, paper
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:478:`14_analysis_of_the_pauli_basis_test.tex:1687-1699`.
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:479:
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:480:Projectivity and completeness of `w.Smeas side` reduce the product to its
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:481:diagonal outcomes. The two Pauli involutions then cancel in reverse order. -/
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:482:theorem swapUnitary_mul_conjTranspose {P : AdmissibleParams}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:483:    {epsilon delta : ℝ} {S : ProjectiveSetting P epsilon}
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:484:    (w : GlobalPairWitness S delta) (side : PlayerSide) :
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:485:    swapUnitary w side * (swapUnitary w side)ᴴ = 1 := by
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:486:  classical
MIPStarRE/QPBT/Extraction/Observables.lean:487:  apply sum_heteroKron_mul_conjTranspose (w.Smeas side) (w.projective side)
